description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison between two models—Flan-T5-783M (blue bars) and a baseline or alternative model (red bars)—across six evaluation metrics derived from three benchmark datasets: TriviaQA, HotPotQA, and 2Wiki, each assessed under two metrics: Exact Match (EM) and F1 score. The vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 25 to 85, with gridlines at intervals of 10. For TriviaQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M achieves 77.3 while the red model scores 77.1; for HotPotQA (EM), the scores are 37.0 (blue) and 31.9 (red); for 2Wiki (EM), 44.5 (blue) and 32.5 (red). In the F1 metric, TriviaQA shows 82.8 (blue) and 83.8 (red), HotPotQA shows 49.7 (blue) and 43.3 (red), and 2Wiki shows 53.3 (blue) and 38.1 (red). The red model slightly outperforms on TriviaQA F1, while Flan-T5-783M leads on all other metrics, with particularly large margins on 2Wiki EM and F1. The bars are grouped by dataset and metric, with blue and red bars paired for direct comparison, and all values are explicitly labeled atop each bar. The chart visually emphasizes Flan-T5-783M’s consistent superiority across most tasks, supporting the paper’s focus on improving multi-round retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) through self-practicing mechanisms that learn when to continue searching.
